title: I made an AI slop game. It’s a multiplayer cyberpunk rooftop runner and the slop is running for its life
author: DerKobe
selftext:
Full disclosure up front: this is certified, free-range, artisanal AI slop. I described a game, an AI wrote basically all of it, and I mostly pressed “yes” and complained about the colors. No artists were harmed because no artists were involved.



What it is: Parallax Runner, a retro pixel-art jump’n’run on rainy Blade-Runner rooftops, presented as a Running-Man-style game show.



Classic platforming: run, double jump, wall jumps, slide.

**Every other player runs in their own lane right behind yours, live. All the lanes form one big parallax city, so you can watch strangers die in real time.**

A Stalker drone flies your exact route a few seconds behind you. Stop to think and it gets you. (Thinking was never the point of slop.)

Spider-bots, floating mines and hover cops patrol the roofs.

Neon grave crosses mark where people died, so you can learn from everyone else’s mistakes. Your best run gets a cross with your name on it. Immortality, sort of.



Play (browser, no signup): [https://parallax-runner.meepmops.de](https://parallax-runner.meepmops.de)

Control: Arrow keys / WASD, Space/Up to jump, Down to slide.



It’s more fun with more people on at once, so if you see other runners, wave. (You can’t wave. That feature got cut. Slop has limits.)



I’d love to hear what’s broken, unfair or unexpectedly fun. Be honest, it can’t get its feelings hurt. It doesn’t have any. I checked.

comments.author: Disastrous-Round-150
comments.body: Anything is better than AAA slop games! 😂
